admission.justification: The owner-state and subject-failure tests guard a plausible false branch warning/currentness judgment; declaration tests also pin the retained status slots.

applicability: The top-line status chip while opening, refreshing, selecting subjects and showing a numbered comparison.
conditions: The four rows are sync movement, external Git movement, subject staleness and bound comparison.

Task-context loading says reading; task-context refusal/failure says unavailable with its reason; selected-subject pending/failure stays in that subject slot and does not make branch status unavailable.
Moved or stale states warn; unread/unmeasured owners remain named; current tone requires both movement owners measured current.
Reason text is the first sentence of the relevant owner text; raw records remain in Technical details.
The chip, comparison label and add slot reserve their space from first paint; a refresh notice has its own row.
exclusions: Inferring branch currentness from a successful subject read or execution test.
Inventing a warning reason in the browser.
Claiming fresh measured browser rectangles or no-shift acceptance from CSS declarations alone.
